infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Lensio uses your camera to let you try on frames and to photograph your prescription.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lensio needs access to your photos so you can upload a picture of your prescription.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lensio uses the microphone so you can search frames and chat with your voice.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Lensio turns your voice into text to search frames and answer your questions.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Lensio uses your location only to show the nearest Lensio store.
